class.name: FellowTerrainFoliage
class.brief_description: A kind of plant or rock a [FellowTerrain3D] scatters over one of its layers.
class.description: One entry of [member FellowTerrain3D.foliage]: the terrain places instances of [member mesh] where [member layer] is, in square cells of [member cell_size] metres around the camera up to [member range], and frees them beyond it. A cell's instances are made once, on a worker thread: points jittered on a grid of [member density], kept with a likelihood that rises from 0 at [member min_weight] to 1 where the layer's weight is 1, where the slope is between [member slope_min] and [member slope_max] and the height between [member height_min] and [member height_max]; each turned, tilted, scaled and sunk as the other properties say. Each cell is a [MultiMesh] of its own (its buffer is written once), and FellowEngine's MultiMesh culling culls its instances one by one beyond [member range]. The same terrain, camera position and seed give the same instances. The mesh's own materials are used (a material with FellowEngine's wind sways as it would in a [MultiMeshInstance3D]). Changing a property scatters the kind again.

members.member: How much an instance is tilted from upright towards the ground's normal (0 upright, as a tree; 1 on the slope, as a rock or a flower).
The side of the square cells the kind is scattered in, made and freed as the camera moves. 0: a quarter of [member range], between 8 and 256 m.
Instances per square metre where the layer's weight is 1 (and the slope and height allow).
The highest ground (the terrain's local height) the kind grows on.
The lowest ground (the terrain's local height) the kind grows on.
The terrain layer (0 to 8) whose weight gives the kind's density.
The mesh each instance draws, with its own materials. Without one, nothing is scattered.
The layer's weight below which there are no instances; from it to 1 the density rises from 0 to [member density].
If [code]true[/code], each instance is turned by a random angle about the vertical.
The distance from the camera in metres up to which the instances are made and drawn.
The largest of the instances' random uniform scales.
The smallest of the instances' random uniform scales.
Another seed gives other positions, angles and scales.
How far below the ground an instance is placed, in metres at scale 1 (a negative value lifts it: a mesh centred on its origin).
The steepest slope in degrees the kind grows on.
The gentlest slope in degrees the kind grows on (rocks on cliffs: a high value).
